title: West Plains Aquatic Center

services.name: Municipal Court
services.desc: The Court will be closed for the following holidays: New Year’s Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Presidents’ Day, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Columbus Day, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving Day & the day following, and Christmas Day. In person: Cash, Money Order, Cashiers Check, Credit/Debit Card; at the courtoffice located inside City Hall at 1910 Holiday Lane, West Plains,MO 65775 Your traffic summons requires you to appear in person before the Municipal Judge in West Plains, Missouri at 9:00am on the date written on your ticket UNLESS you wish to plead guilty and pay your fine prior to that

blurb: The West Plains Aquatic Center is open during the summer season and open to the public seven days a week. It consists of two swimming pools; a smaller pool and a larger lap pool.
